verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's API reference explicitly claims the API can configure integrations, define incidents and set up webhooks, which it describes as "anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI." Token-based API keys act like any other user with Owner permissions by default, and an official MCP server provides agent access. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, but that does not contradict the parity claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of UI/API parity, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and endpoint-level evidence covering areas like Signals, runbooks and retrospectives.
